# truenas_cloudsync_task (Resource)

Manages a cloud sync task on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_dataset" "data" {
  name = "tank/data"
}

resource "truenas_cloudsync_task" "nightly_backup" {
  description = "Nightly S3 backup"
  # Reference the dataset's mountpoint rather than hardcoding the path (e.g.
  # "/mnt/tank/data"). The reference gives Terraform a dependency edge so the
  # dataset is created before the task; a hardcoded path has no such edge and
  # may fail with "path not found" on the first apply.
  path          = truenas_dataset.data.mountpoint
  credentials   = truenas_cloudsync_credentials.backup_s3.id
  direction     = "PUSH"
  transfer_mode = "SYNC"

  attributes = jsonencode({
    bucket = "my-backup-bucket"
    folder = "truenas"
  })

  schedule = {
    minute = "0"
    hour   = "3"
    dom    = "*"
    month  = "*"
    dow    = "*"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attributes` (String) JSON document of provider-specific attributes, e.g. {"bucket": "...", "folder": "..."}.
- `credentials` (Number) ID of the cloud sync credentials to use.
- `description` (String) Task description. Cloud sync tasks have no name field; description serves as the task label.
- `direction` (String) PUSH or PULL.
- `path` (String) Local filesystem path to sync.
- `schedule` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `transfer_mode` (String) SYNC, COPY, or MOVE.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `exclude` (List of String)
- `include` (List of String)
- `post_script` (String)
- `pre_script` (String)
- `snapshot` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week.
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute (e.g. 0, */15).
- `month` (String) Month.
